proposal.reason: Primary change is in network: NET/CollNet selection, plugin lifetime, transport/proxy operations, and shutdown/progress are moved to per-communicator backend state. Add communicator because init/split/free now own netName config, backend compatibility checks for shared-resource parent/child comms, and per-comm backend/U2MM fields. Add device-topology because topology XML/system construction and NIC property discovery now depend on the communicator-selected backend and EIC mode. Add graph-search because PXN disable logic and graph comparison decisions now use per-communicator backend/version and EIC state, changing graph-selection behavior.
